headline: Steal the cool morning. Own the market.
lede: Tuesday, August 18. High 101°, low 70°, almost no rain. This is a heat day. Do the lake or coffee before 9. Hide 11–4. Farmers market 2:30–6:30 at the Landing south lot by Bass Pro — peaches, tomatoes, handmade goods, live music. Farmhouse on Main after, then an air-conditioned theatre.

featured.title: Branson Farmers Market
featured.where: South parking lot by Bass Pro · Branson Landing
featured.why: The one Tuesday that still feels like a small Ozarks town. Local produce, jellies, soaps, baked goods. Free. Park once and walk.

plan.title: Lake or Steamy Joe
plan.detail: Table Rock at first light, or breakfast at The Bradford. Do not start this day at noon.

plan.title: Landing market
plan.detail: South lot by Bass Pro through 6:30. Then Farmhouse on Main if you want a real table.

plan.title: A show, not a hike
plan.detail: Theatres are the smart evening. Confirm tonight’s board — we last verified times Monday.
